subject: Security anchor points for Pioneer MAP: SOC2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA & retention
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: security anchor points for Pioneer MAP (SOC2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Hi Ben & Marissa,

I put together a first-pass MAP skeleton for Pioneer focused on the security/compliance anchors we talked about — SOC 2 evidence expectations, SIG/CAIQ review, DPA redline path, and the default retention policy for hosted deployments. Attaching the MAP draft and a simple evidence index so the customer can see what we can deliver in short order.

Top-level proposal: 
- Entry: technical trial + demo (week of Oct 11)
- Gate 1 (SIG/CAIQ): customer completes CAIQ -> our security team performs a gap review (target completion Oct 20)
- Gate 2 (DPA): legal triage of redlines -> mutual DPA sign (target Oct 25)
- Gate 3 (SOC2): provide SOC 2 Type II report or SOC2 bridge document + evidence indices (target Oct 31)
- Final: deployment/production enablement after all gates green (early Nov)

Open questions for alignment before I share this with Pioneer:
1) Hosted retention default (we currently propose 90 days for request/response logs + 365 days for audit traces) — OK to propose as default?
2) Escrow/KEK options if they require longer-term escrow or key escrow for residency — note that private deployment is an option but will push timelines.
3) Which of these items do we want legal to pre-clear before sending the MAP (DPA redline positions, standard keystore language)?

Action items: please review and comment inline on the attached workbook. If you’re happy, I’ll share a cleaned MAP sheet with Pioneer and ask for their CAIQ + DPA redlines.

Attachments: 20271001-pioneer-map-draft.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-index.xlsx

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Wong <emily.wong@pioneerfin.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: security anchor points for Pioneer MAP (SOC2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Thanks Markus — I synced with Emily this morning and wanted to surface a few adjustments from the Pioneer side before you share the formal MAP: 

- Pioneer is comfortable with a demo week of Oct 11–15 but wants explicit SIG/CAIQ completion before they commit to a technical PO.
- They've already started a CAIQ internally and will send a completed spreadsheet — ask them to include org-chart and a CISO contact.
- Procurement is likely to ask for a dedicated capacity option in pricing (they're evaluating hosted vs dedicated for PII-handling flows).

I think the timeline you proposed is reasonable, but we should call out conditional paths in the MAP: hosted default (90d retention) vs private/VPC (customer-managed retention + residency) and what that means for SOC2 evidence scope.

If you want, I can nudge Legal to pre-clear our standard DPA positions so we can accept small carveouts without starting from scratch.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Subject: Pioneer: CAIQ + DPA redlines (initial)

Hi Markus / Ben / Marissa,

Thanks — attached are the completed CAIQ workbook and our initial DPA redlines. Quick notes from the compliance team: 

- CAIQ: completed (attached). We flagged a few items where we need clarification on KMS, BYOK, and how Redwood handles KV cache persistence.
- DPA: we've redlined standard language around subprocessor notification and international transfer mechanics — our legal team prefers a Data Processing Addendum with SCCs + a short residency carveout for EU customer data.
- SOC2: we do not require a Type II report immediately, but we will need a mapping/bridge document showing the controls and the timeline for a Type II report if your roadmap shows an upcoming audit window.

Two asks before our CISO review on Oct 20: 
1) Can you confirm the default retention period for hosted logs (we expect explicit numbers for retention + deletion windows)?
2) Can you provide a short exec summary of the MAP (1 page) for our CISO and procurement (they want clarity on acceptance gates and who owns each item)?

Attachments: Pioneer-CAIQ-completed.xlsx, Pioneer-DPA-redlines.docx

Best,

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: contracts@pioneerfin.com
Date: 2027-10-08T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pioneer: CAIQ + DPA redlines (initial) — MAP anchors and proposed acceptance timeline

Emily — thanks for the CAIQ and the DPA redlines, those are helpful. Below is a compressed acceptance timeline and who owns each gate — I’ll attach a one-page MAP executive summary and a final anchors PDF after you confirm.

Proposed acceptance anchors (condensed):
- Demo / Technical Trial (entry): Redwood provides a sandbox + test plan (owner: Redwood SE) — target: week of Oct 11
- SIG/CAIQ gap review (Gate A): Pioneer submits completed CAIQ -> Redwood Security performs gap mapping and returns a triage summary (owner: Redwood Security) — target: Oct 20
- DPA triage (Gate B): Pioneer redlines -> Redwood Legal triages and proposes firm positions; aim to reach mutual agreement and DocuSign envelope by Oct 25 (owner: Redwood Legal + Pioneer Legal)
- SOC2 evidence (Gate C): If no Type II is available, Redwood will provide a SOC2 control mapping + evidence index; if Type II exists, provide report. Target for final evidence package: Oct 31 (owner: Redwood Compliance)
- Final go/no-go (Close): after Gate C verification and commercial sign-off (owner: Customer CISO + Redwood AE/Legal) — target: Nov 4

Retention & residency: default hosted model — 90-day request/response logs; 365-day audit traces (encrypted at rest). For customers that require EU residency/extended retention, we can propose a private deployment or a contractual carveout (keystore/escrow options). Note that private deployment will shift timeline by ~4–6 weeks depending on infra.

Attachments: MAP-final-anchors.pdf

Next steps
- I’ll upload the one-page MAP summary and a doc that maps CAIQ to our controls to the shared Drive and send the HubSpot update (link included).
- Ben: please confirm if Legal should pre-clear our DPA positions.

If this looks good I’ll send the formal MAP to Pioneer and request the CAIQ + confirmed CISO meeting slot for Oct 20.

Thanks,
Markus
From: Pioneer Contracts <contracts@pioneerfin.com>

Subject: Re: Pioneer: CAIQ + DPA redlines (initial) — MAP anchors and proposed acceptance timeline

Markus — thanks for the clear timeline. We will present the one-page MAP and the anchors to the CISO on Oct 20. A few quick asks: 

1) Please include a short paragraph describing the SOC2 evidence we will receive if you do not have a Type II report yet (we need a bridge description for our audit team).
2) Include the DocuSign link and expected sign-by date (we aim to sign the DPA by Oct 28 prior to the CISO final decision).

If you can send the 1-page MAP and the SOC2 bridge paragraph by EOD Oct 12, we will include them in the packet.

Contracts (on behalf of Pioneer)
Pioneer Financial
